chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
And whoever conceals it, then indeed his heart is sinful.

key_terms.قَلْبُهُ: his heart; the inner spiritual and moral state
key_terms.كَافِرٌ: disbelieving; marked here as a severe condemnation of the inner state
key_terms.يَكْتُمْهَا: conceals it; hides the testimony that should be disclosed

ai.seo_question: What does "And whoever conceals it, then indeed his heart is sinful" mean in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about concealing testimony by intensifying its meaning: such concealment reflects kufr in the heart. It highlights the grave moral and religious seriousness of hiding testimony and violating truth.
